payload.title: Creating LiPD files from a tabular template
payload.description: This workflow demonstrates how to programmatically create LiPD files from an Excel template using the PyLiPD library. It involves reading metadata, paleo data, and chronology data from specified sheets in the Excel file, and then organizing this information into a structured LiPD dataset. The workflow also covers handling new standard terms and adding ensemble tables to the dataset. The final output is a LiPD file that encapsulates the dataset's metadata, paleo data, and chronology data.

steps.description: Import the required classes from the PyLiPD library to handle datasets, archive types, funding, interpretations, and other components necessary for creating a LiPD file.
steps.title: Import necessary libraries and classes

steps.description: Open the Excel template file and read the metadata sheet to extract root metadata, location metadata, funding metadata, and publication metadata.
steps.title: Open and read the template file

steps.description: Extract and set the root metadata such as dataset name, archive type, and original data URL.
steps.title: Process root metadata

steps.description: Address potential issues with non-standard archive types by creating new archive type entries if necessary.
steps.title: Handle new standard terms

steps.description: Create a Publication object and process author information for the dataset's associated publications.
steps.title: Process publication metadata

steps.description: Create a Location object and set geographical information such as latitude, longitude, and elevation.
steps.title: Process location metadata

steps.description: Extract and process funding information from the metadata.
steps.title: Process funding metadata

steps.description: Create a PaleoData object and extract measurement tables from the paleo data sheet.
steps.title: Process PaleoData

steps.description: Create a ChronData object and extract measurement tables from the chronology data sheet.
steps.title: Process ChronData

steps.description: Add ensemble data from an external CSV file to the dataset.
steps.title: Add ensemble table

steps.description: Write the assembled dataset into a LiPD file format.
steps.title: Write LiPD file

steps.description: Re-open the created LiPD file to verify its contents and ensure the dataset is correctly structured.
steps.title: Open and verify LiPD file
